jobs.description:
Experience in building applications for web, mobile, desktop, or gaming? You’ll be familiar with .NET by Microsoft. This open-source, cross-platform framework (compatible with macOS, Windows, and Linux) supports various programming languages, including the ever-popular C#. Thanks to its high-performance runtime, consistent programming model, and extensive library of precoded solutions .NET enables us to incorporate performance, security, reliability, and productivity into our solutions. 

Pave the way for AI innovations, cloud adoption and digital transformation with Microsoft Azure’s suite of virtual machines, storage solutions, networking, and databases. Problem-solving, collaboration with crossfunctional teams and designing scalable solutions are going to be your key skills as an Azure expert. You’ll also familiarise yourself with Azure Active Directory, monitoring tools, and cost management to deliver the continuous integration and delivery, as well as implementing security best practices, quality and compliance that Sopra Steria is known for.  

Our Developers specialise in application and software development while seamlessly integrating systems, so we never lose sight of our business goals. With an eye towards user experience and productivity, you’ll design, code, and test new functionalities while troubleshooting issues, optimizing performance, and keeping technical documentation in order. Our developers love to design and are always informed of the latest design trends. When fulfilling day-to-day tasks, you’ll always be ready with a solution when there’s a problem. You’ll also collaborate with other teams and never miss a detail so you can deliver solutions that meet Sopra Steria’s quality standards. 

 

Profile

We’re seeking passionate colleagues who are eager to push the boundaries in digital transformation and technology consulting. At Sopra Steria, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your skills in a constructive, collaborative team environment, working on impactful projects that drive change for our clients. If you thrive on challenge and meet (most of) the qualifications below, we look forward to your application! 

• .NET

• Security
• Azure services (Azure Functions/App Services, Azure IoT Hub, Azure DevOps, Azure Kubernetes Services…)
• OO

jobs.occupation: Production associate | With technical skills | Strombeek-Bever | ENG
jobs.description:
We are looking for a production associate for a leading international company in the consumer goods industry.

The company is located in Strombeek-Bever.

Your responsibilities:

 

 
• You prepare, set up, and operate pilot plant equipment for testing activities. 
 
• You perform assigned tests and experiments according to established procedures. 
 
• You reconfigure, adjust, and rebuild machine components when required. 
 
• You collect, retrieve, and accurately document test data. 
 
• You verify data quality and report any anomalies to your supervisor or technical coach. 
 
• You support administrative and reporting tasks related to testing activities. 
 
• You learn and apply new testing methods with a strong focus on quality and reliability. 
 
• You collaborate closely with engineers, scientists, and technical specialists. 

 
• You have a mechanical or electromechanical education or relevant experience. 
 
• You demonstrate strong hands-on technical skills. 
 
• You are comfortable working with machinery and equipment. 
 
• You maintain a high level of accuracy and attention to detail. 
 
• You possess good computer skills and feel confident using software applications. 
 
• You communicate effectively in English, both written and spoken. 
 
• You show a proactive attitude and are willing to ask questions when needed. 
 
• You are comfortable with a role that can be physically demanding at times. 
 
• You are willing to perform tasks that may require working in less comfortable or awkward positions.

We're not looking for someone who aims to become a researcher, but who understands the context and procedures, and thrives in supporting technical research work.

Our client is a European tech group operating across mobility and renewable energy, with several complementary businesses spanning digital media, training, e-commerce, and software.The role focuses on their EV charging platform, a scale-up offering a leading consumer app, a roaming charging solution used across Europe, and a growing B2B SaaS platform for corporate fleets.As part of their international expansion, they are now appointing a Country Manager to build and lead the BeLux market.

Jobomschrijving

As Country Manager, your main responsibilities will be to :

Shape & own the BeLux market strategy

• Define the market vision and priorities for Belgium & Luxembourg, adapting the global framework to local realities.
• Build a deep understanding of drivers, barriers, competitors, and user/company behaviors to inform strategic decisions.
• Identify high-impact growth levers across B2C and B2B.

Accelerate B2C adoption & engagement

• Boost usage of the mobile app and charging access solution through creative, locally relevant activation.
• Work with Marketing on targeted campaigns and growth experiments; ensure seamless onboarding with Customer Success.
• Influence product developments by sharing market insights and feature needs with Product & Tech.

Drive B2B development & support fleet electrification

• Analyze fleet maturity and corporate charging needs to position the B2B SaaS offer effectively.
• Partner with Marketing & Sales to build a solid lead generation engine and qualify opportunities.
• Secure customer satisfaction and long-term usage through close collaboration with Customer Success and B2B Ops.

Turn strategy into execution & measurable results

• Own the BeLux KPIs and P&L: monitor performance, detect weak signals, and propose data-backed improvements.
• Deploy clear action plans and ensure cross-functional alignment for efficient execution.
• Be the operational link between market needs and central teams (Sales, Product, Tech, Marketing, CS).

Build and represent the brand in the local ecosystem

• Become the face of the company in the BeLux market: attend events, engage communities, and expand visibility.
• Develop partnerships with charging networks, installers, service providers, driver associations, and corporate stakeholders.
• Conduct initial discovery visits with prospects, validate opportunities, and coordinate handovers to internal Business Developers.

Prepare the ground for future local expansion

• Identify organizational needs as the market grows and contribute to planning a future local team (Sales, Marketing, etc.).
• Ensure continuous feedback loops to refine positioning, operations, and product-market fit.

The successful candidate will have the following qualities:

• Relevant experience in market development / new market launch / acceleration (ideally in SaaS, digital products, mobility, energy)
• Proven ability to adapt a global strategy to local dynamics and deliver measurable growth.
• Data-driven: confident with KPIs, dashboards, CRM, and translating field insights into action.
• Strong partnership-building mindset with companies, associations, and institutional stakeholders.
• Entrepreneurial, hands-on, and autonomous, with excellent cross-functional collaboration skills.
• Deep understanding of BeLux cultural and business context; EV ecosystem knowledge is a plus.
• Fluent in Dutch and English.

Our client is a key player in the healthcare and social services sector. The work environment is dynamic, collaborative, and innovation‑driven, with a strong focus on modernizing its IT landscape and continuously improving operational performance.

• 
Stay up to date with relevant technologies and propose improvements to enhance the IT landscape.

• Knowledge of relational databases.

• 
Knowledge of Office 365 administration.

They have a strong IT department, and you will join an agile development subteam that works in short sprints on modern cloud-native software. You will take ownership within the team and work together with software engineers, UX designers, product managers, and DevOps profiles to build scalable solutions.
In addition to hands-on development in .NET, you will actively contribute to discussions around architecture, technical choices, quality, and further product development. You will use AI tools to increase your own productivity and that of the team, while remaining personally responsible for the quality and outcome of the work.
You will explore new technologies and AI applications to improve both the development process and the performance of the product. In addition, you will contribute to concrete AI use cases within the software and help the team grow through technical guidance, feedback, and knowledge sharing.

• Master’s degree in Computer Science, IT, or similar
• Strong professional experience in .NET development
• Interest in AI tools
• You work in English, Dutch is a plus

Own critical network infrastructure, work with modern technologies and shape the evolution of IT within a stable, people-focused organisation.

Our partner is a well-established Belgian organisation operating across multiple locations, with a strong focus on service, reliability and digital transformation. Its IT environment supports a broad network of sites and business operations, making availability, security and connectivity essential to its day-to-day activities.

 

As part of a growing IT Infrastructure team, you will join an environment where networking is not simply about keeping systems running: you will have the opportunity to take ownership, work on infrastructure projects and influence how the network evolves.
Network Engineer | The Role
As a Network Engineer, you will take an active role in the operational management and continuous improvement of the organisation's network environment.

• Manage and monitor LAN, WAN, Wi-Fi, VPN and firewall infrastructure across multiple locations.
• Troubleshoot complex network incidents, identify root causes and implement sustainable solutions.
• Work closely with external technology partners, coordinating their activities and challenging proposed solutions when needed.
• Contribute to network projects, migrations, upgrades and standardisation, while ensuring smooth change management.
• Proactively monitor performance, availability and security, using KPIs and monitoring tools to prevent service degradation and downtime.
• Contribute to automation, security and infrastructure improvements, with opportunities to expand into areas such as cloud, systems or cybersecurity.
Network Engineer | The Profile
We are looking for a technically strong Network Engineer who enjoys ownership, problem-solving and working across a broader infrastructure environment.

• 2+ years of experience in Network Engineering, Systems Engineering or IT Infrastructure.
• Solid knowledge of routing, switching, VLANs, Wi-Fi, WAN, VPN, DNS, DHCP and network segmentation.
• Experience with network monitoring, incident management, troubleshooting and change management.
• Familiarity with technologies such as Cisco, Meraki, firewalls, SD-WAN or Network Access Control is a strong plus.
• Interest in automation and scripting using technologies such as PowerShell, Python, Ansible or APIs.
• Fluent in Dutch or French, professionally proficient in the other national language, with a good command of English.

What will you be doing?

During the season:

You will be part of a dynamic, energetic team that processes 45 tons of carrots per hour. Together with your colleagues, you will:

• Monitoring the operation of machines (conveyor belts, scanners, cutting and packaging systems)
• Check quality and make changes when necessary
• Show initiative and make quick decisions in difficult situations
• Detecting faults, responding immediately to breakdowns and making quick operational decisions
• Making settings and quality improvements
• Seasonal maintenance, minor repairs, and support for the maintenance department – replacing belts, lubrication, sensor adjustment, filter checks, etc.
• Working in accordance with health and safety and hygiene regulations

Out of season:

You will assist with maintenance and repairs to keep our equipment in top condition. This is not a lab job—you will be working on robust washing and sorting lines, not delicate machines in clean rooms. Practical knowledge and hands-on skills are essential.

• Solid technical knowledge and a proactive approach
• Good command of English allowing for effective communication
• Experience working with loaders or forklifts is a plus
• You enjoy working outdoors and aren't afraid to get your hands dirty
• You are responsible, independent, and solution-oriented
• Flexibility to support other departments during quieter periods
• During the high season (July, August, September), it is not possible to take vacation

jobs.occupation: AP Accountant I FR-NL I Brussels
jobs.description:
Our client is a leading international retailer known for its collaborative culture, innovation, and continuous improvement mindset.

Jobomschrijving

• Manage and reconcile financial transactions, ensuring accuracy and compliance with accounting standards.
• Participate in monthly, quarterly, and annual closing activities and support financial reporting under BE GAAP and IFRS.
• Perform complex account reconciliations, including intercompany and fixed assets accounts.
• Analyze and optimize financial processes by implementing automation and efficiency improvements.
• Partner with operational teams (stores, e-commerce, logistics) to provide financial insights and support decision-making.
• Identify financial risks, strengthen internal controls, and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Accounting, Finance, or Business Management with at least a first experience in a similar role.
• Strong accounting knowledge with the ability to independently manage complex reconciliations (intercompany, fixed assets).
• Proficient in Excel, with an interest in ERP systems and Generative AI tools.
• Organized, proactive, and able to manage priorities effectively while meeting strict deadlines.
• Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to explain financial information to non-financial stakeholders.
• Fluent in Dutch with a good command of French and English; committed to continuous learning and process improvement.

Responsibilities

• Design and develop secure, performant software solutions using the .NET ecosystem.
• Collaborate with solution designers and stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical implementations.
• Implement Clean Code, Clean Architecture, and SOLID principles to ensure long-term maintainability.
• Develop and optimize .NET Core Web APIs and integrate them with various backend systems.
• Manage cloud infrastructure and containerized deployments using Azure, Kubernetes, and Docker.
• Create meaningful and automated unit tests to guarantee code quality and reliability.

Requirements

• 5+ years of experience in backend development using .NET, including LINQ, async/await, and data structures.
• 3+ years of experience building .NET Core Web APIs.
• 3+ years of cloud development experience using Azure services and PaaS components.
• Proven experience implementing Clean Code, Clean Architecture, and SOLID principles across multiple projects.
• Hands-on experience with unit testing and automated test quality.
• Experience with CI/CD and DevOps practices using Azure DevOps, Kubernetes, and Docker.
• Experience with SQL, database design, and relational database optimization.
• Proficiency in version control and branching strategies using Git.
• You are proactive, professional, and possess strong communication skills.
• You are fluent in English with a native level of Dutch or French.
Nice to Haves

• Experience designing applications with offline usage, local persistence, and synchronization capabilities.
• Knowledge of event-driven patterns and security practices.
